# `outputs/`

**Intentionally empty in the repository.** Every file under `outputs/{SQ1,SQ2,SQ3}/` is regenerated by running the corresponding `code/SQx/` scripts on a fresh clone. The directory structure itself is preserved through `.gitkeep` files.

This is the central reproducibility-rule of the repo:

> The thesis must be re-derivable from `code/` + `data/` + this README, without any committed `outputs/` files.

## What ends up here after a full run

| Folder        | Files (after `code/SQx/` is run)                                                 |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `outputs/SQ1/`| `simulations/datasets/foras_xlsx_baseline.csv` + per-condition `with_sentinels_*.csv`; `simulations/runs/seed_NNN__{baseline,raw,period,full}/` with `recall_curve.csv`, `results.csv`, `summary.json`; `simulations/summary.json` (aggregate); `figures/intro_terminology_drift.png` |
| `outputs/SQ2/`| `simulations/cell_pp{pp}_nn{nn}_seed{s}/summary.json` × 180; `figures/heatmap_wss95.png`, `heatmap_loss.png` |
| `outputs/SQ3/`| TBD — depends on chosen architecture                                              |
